notes: εὐδόκησαν headed on pleasure under rule 66, the corpus glossing the εὐδοκ- lexeme good pleasure with the noun as a real gloss and not a generic completion.
τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ: the article follows its noun before a verbless modifier, so it keeps only that under rule 31 and the preposition carries the supplied copula under rule 53.
